target.title: feat(android): add Skill Workshop settings panel
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Android Settings did not expose the Skill Workshop review queue, so mobile users could not inspect generated skill proposals or perform the same core proposal lifecycle actions available from the Web UI. This left proposal review dependent on desktop/Web access even when the Android app was already connected to a Gateway.

## Summary

- Add a dedicated Android Settings > Skill Workshop panel for proposal review.
- Load proposal lists and details through existing Gateway `skills.proposals.*` RPCs with agent-scope support.
- Auto-load selected proposal details to match Web controller behavior.
- Support pending proposal lifecycle actions from mobile: apply, reject, and quarantine.
- Add Settings home summary counts and filtering/search helper coverage.

## Implementation Notes

- The Android UI uses a mobile list/detail layout rather than the Web desktop board layout.
- No new Gateway API is introduced; Android reuses the existing Skill Workshop RPC methods.
- Gateway responses are guarded against stale list/detail updates during gateway changes.
- Native app i18n inventory was updated for the new Android Settings strings.

## Evidence

- Local static checks passed on the PR branch:
  - `git diff --check`
  - `git diff --cached --check`
  - `pnpm native:i18n:check`
  - `pnpm android:i18n:check`
- Added unit coverage for Skill Workshop settings summary and filtering helpers in `ShellScreenLogicTest`.
- GitHub Actions passed on commit `f11bbb23a0eb50519587ad6b9a038cbde0b8482c`:
  - CI: `android-ktlint`, `android-build-play`, `android-test-play`, `android-test-third-party`, `native-i18n`, `check-docs`, preflight/security/check shards, Node shards, and QA smoke jobs.
  - Real behavior proof passed.
  - Workflow Sanity, OpenGrep PR diff, Dependency Guard, Security Sensitive Guard, Socket PR alerts, and ClawSweeper Dispatch passed.

## Not Run Locally

- Android ktlint/build/tests were not run locally because this environment has no `java`/`JAVA_HOME` available. Android verification was run in GitHub Actions instead.

## Risk

- Moderate UI/RPC surface change isolated to Android Settings and existing Skill Workshop Gateway methods.
- No dependency, workflow, release, or Gateway API surface changes.

## Supplemental Media Evidence

Evidence pack branch: https://github.com/snowzlmbot/openclaw/tree/evidence/pr-101911-skill-workshop/pr-101911-media

Media links:
- PR overview at latest head: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/snowzlmbot/openclaw/evidence/pr-101911-skill-workshop/pr-101911-media/pr-overview.png
- PR checks at latest head: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/snowzlmbot/openclaw/evidence/pr-101911-skill-workshop/pr-101911-media/pr-checks.png
- Android Skill Workshop UI diff proof: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/snowzlmbot/openclaw/evidence/pr-101911-skill-workshop/pr-101911-media/skill-workshop-ui-file.png
- Android Gateway RPC diff proof: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/snowzlmbot/openclaw/evidence/pr-101911-skill-workshop/pr-101911-media/node-runtime-rpc-file.png
- Capture status JSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/snowzlmbot/openclaw/evidence/pr-101911-skill-workshop/pr-101911-media/pr-status.json

Runtime proof boundary: a paired Android node was present but offline at evidence time; `nodes.notify` failed with `node not connected`. These media artifacts supplement the latest-head CI/source-path evidence and do not claim to be a live Android device screenshot. Live Android Settings > Skill Workshop media should be added when a device/emulator is available.
